title: Marginal-Contribution Policy Gradients under Filtered Feedback for Multi-Agent LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.22785v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a unified treatment of credit assignment for RL training in multi-agent LLM systems. We show that observed reward alone cannot distinguish an agent that determines it from one that never affects it, and that standard shared-reward training performs exact gradient ascent on each agent's private utility rather than system performance. Moreover, we prove no single scalar per agent can consistently account for joint performance once agents interact. We thus develop the unique background-dependent notion of marginal contribution satisfying natural consistency requirements. From it we derive gradient-correct marginal contribution training signals, identify them from filtered feedback, and optimally allocate a budget of exact counterfactual evaluations against learned-signal error. Instantiated in GRPO, our signal improves routed GSM8K accuracy over winner-take-all training at no extra generation cost.

translated_title: 过滤反馈下面向多智能体大语言模型的边际贡献策略梯度
translated_abstract: 我们为多智能体大语言模型系统中的强化学习训练提出了一种统一的功劳分配处理方法。我们证明，仅凭观测到的奖励无法区分真正决定该奖励的智能体与从未影响该奖励的智能体，且标准的共享奖励训练实际上是在对每个智能体的私有效用而非系统性能进行精确的梯度上升。此外，我们证明，一旦智能体之间存在交互，任何单一的每个智能体标量都无法一致地解释联合性能。因此，我们发展出了唯一满足自然一致性要求的、依赖于背景的边际贡献概念。由此我们推导出梯度正确的边际贡献训练信号，从过滤反馈中识别这些信号，并针对学习信号的误差最优地分配精确反事实评估的预算。在GRPO中实例化后，我们的信号在不增加额外生成成本的情况下，相较于赢家通吃训练提升了路由GSM8K的准确率。
tldr: 本文提出了多智能体大语言模型强化学习训练中唯一满足一致性要求的边际贡献功劳分配理论，通过从过滤反馈中识别梯度正确的边际贡献信号并最优分配反事实评估预算，在GRPO中无需额外生成成本即提升了路由GSM8K准确率。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a uniquely consistent marginal-contribution credit assignment framework for multi-agent LLM RL training, deriving gradient-correct signals from filtered feedback with optimally allocated counterfactual evaluation budgets, improving routed GSM8K accuracy in GRPO at no extra generation cost.
